1½ tbsp cumin ~10g (1 tbsp ≈6-7g). Known cal value copied; modest amount for seasoning.
Standard can of refried beans is 15oz (425g). Known cal value copied.
12 hard taco shells; typical shell ~22-28g each (standard corn taco shell weight). Cal density from typical hard taco shells (~480kcal/100g).
2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend ≈225g (1 cup shredded cheese ≈110-115g). Cal density from typical Mexican blend (~400kcal/100g).
'Halved' grape tomatoes for 12+ tacos assumed ~150g (1-2 cups or ~20-25 small tomatoes). Known cal value copied.
1-2 sliced/seeded jalapeños ≈30g total for topping 12 tacos. Known cal value copied.
1 large avocado (peeled/sliced for guacamole) ≈150g edible flesh. Known cal value copied.
2 tbsp green salsa ≈30g. Cal density estimated from typical salsa verde (~45kcal/100g).
